steps.caption: Integrations
steps.narration: Integrations is where the CRM connects to the other tools you use. Here is each card.

steps.caption: HOVER measurements
steps.narration: First is HOVER, for measurements. Once connected, a completed job lands on the matching client.

steps.caption: Status on every card
steps.narration: Every card shows its status. This one reads connected.

steps.caption: Lead capture
steps.narration: Next comes Lead capture. It is a form for your website, and each submission becomes a client.

steps.caption: The bottom of the page
steps.narration: At the bottom of the page are two tools for your own software.

steps.caption: Webhooks
steps.narration: A webhook tells another system when something happens, like an estimate being approved.

steps.caption: API keys
steps.narration: An API key gives a tool read-only access to your data. Create one only when a tool asks for it.

steps.caption: CladAI: coming soon
steps.narration: Above those, CladAI is marked coming soon. For now, its reports are imported by hand.

steps.caption: Stripe payments
steps.narration: With Stripe payments connected, clients pay invoices online, straight to your Stripe account.

steps.caption: Google Calendar
steps.narration: And Google Calendar pushes your schedule to a calendar of its own in Google.

steps.caption: Open
steps.narration: Open, on a card, takes you to the page where that connection is set up.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: Integrations is near the bottom of the left menu.

youtube.description: What each card on the ConstructHUB CRM Integrations page connects: HOVER measurements, the lead capture form for your website, Stripe payments, Google Calendar, API keys and webhooks. Recorded in a demo workspace where the accounts are stand-ins.
